resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources disagree: a late-July 1931 newspaper report says the new tower was completed, while firelookout.com says built about 1933 and Forest Lookouts lists a c.1933 L-6 patrol tower addition. The story gives both dates and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Destruction in 1955 is agreed by all three lookout listings. The Forest Lookouts page has a '1969: Destroyed' line directly above the NIRA POINT entry; that line belongs to Nira Point, not Graham, and is not used. The June 1930 lightning and fire item and the July 1931 completion report are quoted on the Forest Lookouts page from the Spokane Daily Chronicle; the original newspaper was not checked. The 'open to hikers' claim rests on one 2016 hiking blog, not an agency source. The 'Granham Peak' spelling in the 1930 item is the newspaper's, not ours.
